name: JSON Fields
description: Match JSON messages by a field's value, and show a JSON message as a table with the field's previous value.

permissionReasons.ui: Shows the JSON message as a table in a popup.
permissionReasons.history.read: Finds the field's previous value in earlier messages of the same topic.

providers.name: JSON field equals
providers.description: The message is JSON and the field (dot path) equals the value.

providers.name: Show JSON as a table
providers.description: Popup listing the JSON fields, plus the previous value of one field.
